bitcoin_articles.headline: Hyperscale Data Announces Updated Bitcoin Treasury and Cash Holdings
bitcoin_articles.summary: Hyperscale Data, Inc. reported that as of May 10, 2026, it held 686.7245 Bitcoin and approximately $37.8 million in cash and restricted cash.

bitcoin_articles.headline: MicroCloud Hologram Launches Quantum Key Distribution Solution for Bitcoin
bitcoin_articles.summary: MicroCloud Hologram Inc. has introduced a proprietary quantum key distribution (QKD) technology solution designed to support the transition of Bitcoin's network to post-quantum protocols.
